LightningComponentBundle.description: A gauge chart for displaying single KPI values using D3.js

property.name: soqlQuery
property.label: SOQL Query
property.description: Query to fetch data. Use aggregate query for single value (e.g., SELECT COUNT(Id) total FROM Lead)

property.name: valueField
property.label: Value Field
property.description: API name of the numeric field to display

property.name: advancedConfig
property.label: Advanced Config (JSON)
property.description: JSON configuration: {label, valueFormat, zones, customColors, minValue, maxValue}. minValue/maxValue here override the Minimum/Maximum Value properties above.

property.name: targetRecordId
property.label: Target Record ID
property.description: Record ID to navigate to on click

property.name: objectApiName
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: Object API name to query for the GraphQL data source

property.name: fetchMode
property.label: Data Source
property.description: How to fetch data: auto (existing priority order), apex (Apex-backed SOQL), or graphql (UI API GraphQL)
